chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid narrated to me from his father from Muhammad b. Abi Umayr from Abdullah b. al-Hasan b. al-Hasan b. Ali from his father from his grandfather. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever says 'May Allah bless Muhammad and his family,' Allah, exalted be His majesty, says: 'May Allah bless you.' So let him increase in that.
And whoever says 'May Allah bless Muhammad' and does not bless his family will not find the fragrance of Paradise, and its fragrance can be found from a journey of five hundred years away.

key_terms.خمسمائة عام: Five hundred years - the distance from which Paradise's fragrance can be detected
key_terms.ريح الجنة: The fragrance of Paradise - symbolic of Paradise's blessings
key_terms.صلى الله على محمد وآله: May Allah bless Muhammad and his family - the complete form of salawat

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for blessing both Prophet Muhammad and his family, and what happens if one does not include his family?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) emphasizes the critical importance of including his family (Aal) in the salawat (blessings). When a believer blesses both Muhammad and his family, God Himself responds with blessings upon that person. However, anyone who blesses the Prophet alone without including his family will be deprived of even the fragrance of Paradise. This teaching, narrated through the Hasanid line, underscores the inseparability of the Prophet and his household in Islamic devotion.
